search_parameters.q: What is the current repo rate set by the Reserve Bank of India?

header: The current repo rate set by the Reserve Bank of India is 5.25%, according to the RBI’s official policy rates table.

text_blocks.snippet: Direct Answer: The RBI’s official website lists the Policy Repo Rate as 5.25% Reserve Bank of India . This matches the latest monetary policy updates from BankBazaar BankBazaar and ClearTax ClearTax .
snippet_highlighted_words: RBI’s official website lists the Policy Repo Rate as 5.25%

list.snippet: The repo rate was cut to 5.25% in December 2025 1 .
The RBI kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% during the June 2026 MPC meeting 1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25%

list.snippet: The October 2026 MPC meeting (scheduled for 5–7 October 2026) has not yet updated the rate in the supplied results 1 .

text_blocks.snippet: A 5.25% repo rate indicates a neutral-to-accommodative monetary stance, balancing inflation control with economic growth. It influences loan EMIs, deposit rates, and overall liquidity in the Indian financial system.

references.snippet: Reserve Bank of India · monetary policy RBI repo rate today: 5.25 % The repo rate is 5.25%, unchanged since RBI cut it by 25 basis points on 5 December 2025. The Monetary Policy Committee held it at its latest meeting on 5 August 2026; the next decision is due on 7 October 2026. With CPI inflation at 4.82% (August 2026), the real repo rate is about 0.43%.
